criteria.detail: the class names each table is read under are found in that table's own header rows, and hand-checked cells parse to their printed terms: four on the Visa schedule and seven on Mastercard's, where rows are rebuilt from word positions (a continued label, a cap printed on the line under the rates, a class column past the label, a printed N/A read as absent). Header words missing: none. Hand-checked cells: 11 of 11 match. Mastercard rows rebuilt: 119; cells in them that are neither one rate nor N/A, which Mastercard never prints and a misplaced word would make: 0.
criteria.name: B123-1

criteria.detail: the class index is the card's or its issuer's: in the regulatory tables exactly one column is the regulated issuer's and the rest are exempt issuers', a line 12 CFR 235.5 draws at ten billion dollars of issuer assets, which the merchant can neither see nor choose; in the product tables the columns are card products. Tables breaking the one-regulated-column shape: none.
criteria.name: B123-2

criteria.detail: two answers known before the schedule is read. First, every regulated cell must be the cap 12 CFR 235.3 sets, 0.05 per cent plus $0.21, and one cent more where the fraud adjustment of 12 CFR 235.4 applies (Visa stars it, Mastercard prints it as its own row): 83 of 83 cells are (63 on Visa's schedule, 20 on Mastercard's two editions). Second, the Board's covered average fee must not exceed $0.22 + 0.05% of the covered average ticket, plus half a cent for the printed rounding: 220 of 220 network-years hold.
criteria.name: B123-3

criteria.detail: the registered reading: the printed schedule does not factor, so squares with four present cells are non-zero on every declared setting. Regulatory tables: Visa 237 read (152 holding one sign), 69 zero, 21 unread; Mastercard 431 read (281 holding one sign), 15 zero, 16 unread. Product tables: Visa 4209 read (4041 holding one sign), 1385 zero, 16 unread; Mastercard 2156 read (1827 holding one sign), 818 zero, 40 unread. A square is read where it is non-zero on every setting its cells apply to, out of 6 tickets, two transforms and the fraud cent; whether its sign also holds is printed and decides nothing.
criteria.name: B123-4

criteria.detail: separable rival on the networks' own card products. It covers any class markup the same on every program. Read: 6365 squares non-zero on every setting, 5868 of them holding one sign throughout; 2203 exactly zero on every setting (pairs of products a network prices identically on both programs). By network: Visa 4209 read (4041 holding one sign), 1385 zero, 16 unread; Mastercard 2156 read (1827 holding one sign), 818 zero, 40 unread. A criterion of this kind passes when the rival is wrong.
criteria.name: B123-5
criteria.rival_entailment: the ratio of two classes' prices is the same on every program, so every square's log sum is zero, on every ticket and in either transform
criteria.rival_premise: log price(program, class) = phi(program) + psi(class): one scalar on programs and one factor per class

criteria.detail: separable rival on the statutory line, exempt against regulated issuers. The regulated column is one cap on every program (Visa prints it in every row, Mastercard once for all purchases) and the exempt column varies by program, so the class ratio moves with the program. Read: 668 squares non-zero on every setting, 433 of them holding one sign throughout; 84 zero, 37 unread. By network: Visa 237 read (152 holding one sign), 69 zero, 21 unread; Mastercard 431 read (281 holding one sign), 15 zero, 16 unread.
criteria.name: B123-6
criteria.rival_entailment: the ratio of two classes' prices is the same on every program, so every square's log sum is zero, on every ticket and in either transform
criteria.rival_premise: log price(program, class) = phi(program) + psi(class): one scalar on programs and one factor per class

criteria.detail: every file read is in the fetch manifest with the SHA-256 of the bytes on disk, and every table's pages, class list, rows used and rows left out (with the reason) are printed into the record. Files read: 4; not matching the manifest: none. Rows left out: 46.
criteria.name: B123-7
